entry.title: Miramare Castle

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: The inspected aerial picture confirms the ivory angled crenellated wings, recessed entrance, sea-side bay and southwest square clock tower with four corner turrets. Standard viewer PMTiles and the retained building outline set approximate coastal location and signed orientation. Coarse inland ground rises above the anchor sample; a reconstructed7.2m working rise clears it, with bounded castle foundations extending below the sampled slope. This is approximate fit, not a surveyed sea/terrace datum. Anchor 13.712453245,45.702528846; heading 0.008338727695; standard PMTiles datum 3.7358245453613077m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
